versions.subject: Redcannary 20220820
versions.detection:
selection_cmd:
    - OriginalFileName: Cmd.Exe
    - Image|endswith: \cmd.exe
selection_read:
    - ParentCommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'cmd '
        - '/r '
        - '<'
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'cmd '
        - '/r '
        - '<'   
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: OriginalFileName="Cmd.Exe" OR Image="*\\cmd.exe" (ParentCommandLine="*cmd *" ParentCommandLine="*/r *" ParentCommandLine="*<*") OR (CommandLine="*cmd *" CommandLine="*/r *" CommandLine="*<*")
